content.short: Bailout is an NFT lending platform that lets users lend, provide liquidity and obtain NFT loans.
content.description: Bailout is an NFT lending platform that connects borrowers seeking NFT ownership with liquidity providers who fund NFT loans. In this system, lenders contribute to collection-specific pools that supply ETH for financing. Borrowers select an NFT from an approved collection and pay up to 25% of the floor price to acquire it. Liquidity providers can withdraw their funds at any time, without being forced to wait for a specific borrower to repay or to risk losing earned interest.
